subject.title: feat: keep main agents aware of group activity

question: Should same-agent group activity become ambient main-session context by default whenever the effective binding scope is `main`, given that it adds a guarded tree-read path to previously separate group sessions?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes the visibility and context boundary without a new operator setting; maintainer confirmation should distinguish this product policy from the mechanical propagation repair.

options.title: Keep the scoped ambient-watch design
options.body: Retain the feature for effective `dmScope="main"`, require complete native-command propagation and end-to-end proof before merge.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep current isolation as the default and expose the behavior only through a separately approved configuration or product setting.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a broader session-visibility policy for group context.

recommendation.title: Keep the scoped ambient-watch design
recommendation.body: Retain the feature for effective `dmScope="main"`, require complete native-command propagation and end-to-end proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed session-watch policy and all follow-up scope/visibility commits in this PR are authored by steipete.
